query: I am from Austria working in agricultural studies. Are there any open calls or upcoming calls that would be relevant for me?
response:
As an intelligent research assistant for EU funding, I can confirm that agricultural studies, sustainable food systems, and soil health are key priorities within Horizon Europe, specifically in **Cluster 6 (Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources, Agriculture & Environment)** and the **EU Missions**.

Austria is an eligible EU Member State, allowing full participation and coordination in all these calls. Below are relevant open or upcoming opportunities:

### 1. Primary Funding: Cluster 6 & EU Missions

Your most relevant calls are found under Cluster 6 (focused on Farm to Fork strategy) and the specific Mission on Soil Health.

| ID | Title Summary | Type | Relevance | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **HORIZON-CL6-2025-02-FARM2FORK-19** | Developing agroecology living labs and lighthouses for climate action... | RIA/IA | Sustainable farming, climate resilience, agroecology networks. | Open/Upcoming |
| **HORIZON-MISS-2025-SOIL-01-02** | Living Labs for soil remediation and green redevelopment of brownfields | RIA | Focused on practical, large-scale soil health demonstration and land rehabilitation. | Open/Upcoming |
| **HORIZON-CL6-*-BIODIV-*** (Upcoming) | Topics focused on biodiversity, ecosystem services, and sustainable land management (Check Work Programme for specifics). | RIA/IA | Biodiversity conservation related to agriculture. | Upcoming (2025/2026) |

**Note on CL6 Consortiums**: These Cluster 6 calls typically fund Research and Innovation Actions (RIA) or Innovation Actions (IA), meaning they require multinational consortiums (min 3 partners from 3 EU/AC countries) with budgets usually ranging from **€5 to €10 million**.

### 2. Cross-Cutting & Related Opportunities

Agricultural expertise is often crucial for projects in the energy and environment sectors (Cluster 5 and Cluster 6, Zero Pollution). 

| ID | Title Summary | Cluster | Relevance |
|---|---|---|---|
| **HORIZON-CL5-2026-02-D3-02** | Advanced biofuels and renewable fuels of non-biological origin value chains | Cluster 5 | Projects concerning biomass feedstock, sustainable farming, regenerative practices, and carbon removal technologies are highly relevant here. |
| **HORIZON-MISS-2026-07-CROSS-03** | Advancing lead markets and proof-of-concept for deep tech solutions contributing to EU Missions | Missions | For agricultural deep-tech innovations that support the Soil Mission or Climate Adaptation. |

### 3. Individual/Mobility Funding: MSCA

As a researcher, you are also eligible for the thematic-neutral Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA), which are open to **ALL research domains**, including agriculture:

*   **MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships (MSCA-PF)**: Supports experienced researchers (PhD holders) to undertake 1 to 2 years of individual research and mobility abroad. Excellent for individual career development and establishing international partnerships. Typical grant value is **€200,000 – €300,000** per fellow.
*   **MSCA Doctoral Networks (MSCA-DN)**: Supports international consortiums (min 3 partners) to train doctoral candidates in specific research areas, including sustainable agriculture and food systems. Typical grant value is **€2 – €4 million** per network.

---

### Next Steps and Resources for Agriculture/Food Research

1.  **Review Topic Scope**: Carefully read the **Work Programme** descriptions for the specific call IDs (e.g., HORIZON-CL6-2025-02-FARM2FORK-19) to ensure your project idea aligns perfectly with the expected outcomes.
2.  **Find Partners**: Most calls require a consortium. Look for organizations with complementary expertise across the EU/Associated Countries.

🎯 **Agriculture/Food Research Resources:**
• **Cluster 6 Work Programme**: [Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON)
• **EU Mission Soil Portal**: [Soil Mission Portal](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/funding/funding-opportunities/funding-programmes-and-open-calls/horizon-europe/eu-missions-horizon-europe/soil-deal-europe_en)
• **MSCA Portal**: [MSCA Actions](https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/)
• **Search Calls**: [EU Funding Portal - Topic Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
